---
title: "Variation of Parameters Flowchart"
format: html
---

<style>
.flow-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 700px;
  background-color: #fefefe;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(7, auto);
  align-items: center;
  justify-items: center;
  padding: 30px;
  gap: 20px;
}

.box {
  border: 2px solid #444;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: white;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 16px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  max-width: 300px;
}
#b1{
 background: #e3f2fd;          /* light blue background */
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
}

#b2{
 background: #e3f2fd;          /* light blue background */
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
}

#b3{
 background: #aedaddff;          
  border: 2px solid #19d29bff;
}
#b4{
background: #aedaddff;          
  border: 2px solid #19d29bff;
}
#b5{
 background: #aedaddff;          
  border: 2px solid #19d29bff;
}
#b6{
 background: #aedaddff;          
  border: 2px solid #19d29bff;

}
#b7{
 background: #e3f2fd;          /* light blue background */
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
}
#b8{
 background: #e3f2fd;          /* light blue background */
  border: 2px solid #1976d2;
}
</style>

<div class="flow-container">

<div id="b1" class="box" style="grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1;">
ODE <br> \(a_2 y'' + a_1 y' + a_0 y = g(x)\)
</div>

<div id="b2" class="box" style="grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2;">
Complementary Solution <br> \(y_c = c_1 y_1 + c_2 y_2\)
</div>

<div id="b3" class="box" style="grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2;">
Wronskian \(W\)
</div>

<div id="b4" class="box" style="grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3;">
Standard Form <br> \(y'' + P(x)y' + Q(x)y = f(x)\)
</div>

<div id="b5" class="box" style="grid-column: 3; grid-row: 4;">
Wronskians \(W_1, W_2\)
</div>

<div id="b6" class="box" style="grid-column: 3; grid-row: 5;">
Integrate <br>
\[
u_1' = \frac{y_2 f(x)}{W}, \quad
u_2' = \frac{y_1 f(x)}{W}
\]
</div>

<div id="b7" class="box" style="grid-column: 2; grid-row: 6;">
Particular Solution <br> \(y_p = u_1 y_1 + u_2 y_2\)
</div>

<div id="b8" class="box" style="grid-column: 2; grid-row: 7;">
Final Solution <br> \(y = y_c + y_p\)
</div>

</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leader-line/1.0.7/leader-line.min.js"></script>
<script>
window.onload = function() {
  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b1'),
    document.getElementById('b2'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b2'),
    document.getElementById('b3'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b3'),
    document.getElementById('b4'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b4'),
    document.getElementById('b5'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b5'),
    document.getElementById('b6'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b6'),
    document.getElementById('b7'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b7'),
    document.getElementById('b8'),
    {color: 'grey'}
  );

  // 🔽 NEW ARROW: Comp. Solution → Particular Solution
  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('b2'),
    document.getElementById('b7'),
    {color: 'grey', dash: {animation: true}}
  );
}
</script>
